issue: Segment and normal mapper return identity-like ppn=vpn; descriptor has no PA mapping
evidence_or_observation: Frozen Core translation backend and weight_segment_map::translate return VPN-derived PPN
performance_or_correctness_impact: Bypasses VA-to-PA, contiguity, remap and PA arithmetic; can materially change hit latency and correctness
minimum_resolution: Approve contiguous-PA descriptor with pinning proof or a timed/coherent indirect mapping

issue: OBJECT_WEIGHT object map gates segment eligibility but is simulator metadata
evidence_or_observation: Frozen state machine classifies object before segment hit; map parser is not hardware provenance
performance_or_correctness_impact: Hardware cannot intrinsically know ML object identity; a tenant could otherwise label arbitrary VA
minimum_resolution: Privileged driver installs context-bound verified range descriptors; object map becomes telemetry only

issue: No Segment port, bank, queue, or backpressure state
evidence_or_observation: 35 clusters each have 1 L1 port; Segment lookup only receives ready_cycle=cycle+latency
performance_or_correctness_impact: Shared 1-port versus per-SM/multi-bank design can queue and change both hits and misses
minimum_resolution: Choose placement/topology, aggregate ports, queue depth and conflict timing

issue: State machine waits L1 and Segment; L1 hit waits Segment completion
performance_or_correctness_impact: Queue or longer Segment lookup can hurt every L1 hit; L1-first/cancel changes semantics
minimum_resolution: Approve wait-both versus L1-first/cancel policy and completion ownership

issue: Fixed 10cy is not decomposed into compare, PA, permission, epoch, routing or queue
evidence_or_observation: Config fixes L1=10cy and Segment=10cy; no topology is modeled
performance_or_correctness_impact: C7 break-even changes once service/queue latency changes
minimum_resolution: Derive latency from chosen symbolic microarchitecture or calibrate a bounded model

issue: No context, permissions, mapping kind, epoch, install/revoke or shootdown state
evidence_or_observation: Software descriptor stores only start/end and current requests use ASID 0
performance_or_correctness_impact: Stale PA/permissions after migration, remap, free or ASID reuse are correctness failures
minimum_resolution: Implement/validate runtime contract with atomic update and epoch or invalidation

issue: N=1 only; no per-context quota, overflow, replica or update scaling
evidence_or_observation: Current config has one descriptor and no context-tagged table
performance_or_correctness_impact: N=4/16/64 changes storage, compare topology and isolation
minimum_resolution: Choose context-indexed capacity/placement/overflow policy and report symbolic scaling

issue: Only complete request within descriptor hits
evidence_or_observation: C7 shows 100% declared range coverage; cross-boundary request conservatively misses
performance_or_correctness_impact: Conservative fallback preserves correctness; affects coverage only
minimum_resolution: Retain explicit boundary test and describe tail-page policy

issue: Suppressed counters are state-path counters, not physical counterfactual resource events
evidence_or_observation: C4 conservation shows 512 semantic suppressions while MSHR merging reduces physical events
performance_or_correctness_impact: Avoids false claim that 512 independent walks/PTEs were removed
minimum_resolution: Keep labels and avoid physical savings claim without counterfactual model

issue: 16-leaf semantics are authorized approximation, not target-exact evidence
evidence_or_observation: C1 froze REFERENCE_APPROX_SUBENTRY_16 after evidence audit
minimum_resolution: Retain label; obtain reference details only if target-fidelity claim is later needed

issue: 768 groups can hold 12,288 leaves versus 768 exact pages
evidence_or_observation: 16 leaf slots/group; same config entry parameter reused under changed unit
performance_or_correctness_impact: Can falsely attribute raw capacity provisioning to compression/replacement benefit
minimum_resolution: Choose equal-bit G or leaf-capacity-matched exact baseline

issue: Base-tag compare plus leaf mux/fill are all folded into fixed 80cy
evidence_or_observation: Source uses group hit/leaf select but config gives one L2 latency
performance_or_correctness_impact: Critical path, banking and fill conflicts may differ from exact TLB
minimum_resolution: Specify tag/data array topology, fill arbitration and latency policy

issue: Leaf/group scoped invalidate, racing fills, ASID reuse and page migration not hardware modeled
evidence_or_observation: Candidate carries software ASID/page size but no hardware invalidation protocol
performance_or_correctness_impact: Stale sibling leaves or context leakage are correctness risks
minimum_resolution: Define group/leaf epoch/shootdown behavior and test it before claim

issue: Candidate rejects 2MiB while standard exact mode supports it
evidence_or_observation: C1 scope is 64KiB-only; superpage overlap/promotion unimplemented
performance_or_correctness_impact: Comparison can exclude a meaningful same-budget alternative
minimum_resolution: Approve page-size workload/OS policy and include or explicitly bound 2MiB alternative

issue: 128 PWC entries have unknown payload and cannot be compared by raw count
evidence_or_observation: Config gives PWC entry count/latency only
performance_or_correctness_impact: Can make storage allocation comparison unfair
minimum_resolution: Define PWC tag/pointer state, ports and total bit budget

issue: Three-kernel replay observes one valid subentry leaf and a static map
evidence_or_observation: C4/C7 recorded no existing-group fill or dynamic lifecycle events
performance_or_correctness_impact: Does not exercise occupancy, replacement, multi-context or update behavior
minimum_resolution: Do not generalize; use later bounded tests only after C5 gate is cleared

issue: Parallel state machine has aligned data/store/atomic telemetry in C4
evidence_or_observation: C4 frontend hashes match across profiles and directed tests passed
performance_or_correctness_impact: Supports simulator semantic ownership, not hardware protocol completeness
minimum_resolution: Retain regression evidence when any approved model work begins
